Container.Name: dcv-stt-chain
Container.Registry: Build it first: docker build -t dcv-stt-chain:0.1.0 stt-chain/ (a published image is not available yet)
Container.Overview: Wyoming speech-to-text proxy (double-check-voice). v0.1 is pass-through to faster-whisper with logging of every run. LAN only: Wyoming has no authentication.

Config.Name: DCV_LISTEN_URI
Config.Description: Where the proxy listens. Host networking is used so the proxy sees Home Assistant's real IP. Set this to tcp://(this server's LAN IP):10310 so only that address listens. Add it in Home Assistant as a Wyoming engine on that host and port. Each profile needs its own port.

Config.Name: DCV_DEVICE
Config.Description: Device or profile name used in logs and audio file names

Config.Name: DCV_ALLOWED_PEERS
Config.Description: Home Assistant's IP address (comma-separated for more than one). Required: the proxy refuses to start with this empty, because Wyoming has no authentication. Check the peer field in the logs: it should be HA's own IP, never the Docker gateway.

Config.Name: DCV_AUDIO_RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: Days of raw audio to keep

Config.Name: DCV_MODE
Config.Description: passthrough, or compare (also ask Speech-to-Phrase and log both answers; Home Assistant still hears Whisper only). compare needs DCV_PHRASE_URI.

Config.Name: DCV_PHRASE_URI
Config.Description: Speech-to-Phrase Wyoming address, e.g. tcp://192.168.1.40:10301 (enable the app host port first). Only used in compare mode.

Config.Name: DCV_RUN_LOG_FILE
Config.Description: 1 = also write each run's log line next to the audio clips (runs_(device).jsonl). Contains transcripts. Set 0 to turn off.

Config.Name: DCV_DECISION
Config.Description: off, or shadow: ask Home Assistant which text it could act on and log the decision it would make (Home Assistant still hears Whisper only). shadow needs the next three settings.

Config.Name: DCV_HA_URL
Config.Description: Home Assistant websocket, e.g. ws://192.168.1.30:8123/api/websocket (ws:// sends the token unencrypted).

Config.Name: DCV_HA_TOKEN_FILE
Config.Description: Path inside the container of the token file (map it below). Use a long-lived token of a NON-admin Home Assistant user.

Config.Name: HA token file
Config.Description: A file on this server holding the Home Assistant token (chown 99:100, chmod 400; not in a shared folder). Remove this line unless DCV_DECISION=shadow.

Config.Name: Audio
Config.Description: Raw command audio (WAV), kept for replay
